decisions.reason: A reference class electrometer sits at the core of the firm's decades of dosimetry and calibration expertise, so with in-house R&D and research cooperation the firm can readily interpret results and refine it, and its home-page prominence signals strategic importance.

Oncology risk management software builds on the firm's QA software integration capabilities and its strategy of converging machine and patient QA, so its R&D-intensive knowledge base allows it to assimilate feedback, though it lies somewhat further from the core measurement business than Product A.
